scope: Autonomous hardware reference and analytical performance model for S2Arm on iPhone 16 Pro Max (Apple A18 Pro). Built exclusively from public hardware specifications, Apple/ARM/Metal technical documentation, and S2Arm source analysis — zero personal user logs or measurements.

epistemic_separation.public_hardware_specs: Published architectural parameters from Apple documentation, Metal Feature Set Tables, ARMv9.2-A ISA manuals, and public microarchitectural analyses.
epistemic_separation.automated_host_measurements: Deterministic comparative microbenchmarks and Valgrind Callgrind/Cachegrind instruction & A18-Pro-geometry cache simulations executed >= 5 times per variant on Linux x86-64.
epistemic_separation.analytical_a18pro_projections: First-order latency/bandwidth/energy estimates derived from automated operation counters and public A18 Pro parameters, explicitly annotated with uncertainty margins. Never converted from Geekbench or 3DMark scores.
epistemic_separation.physical_device_verification: UNVERIFIED — no physical iPhone 16 Pro Max is attached to this environment. Real FPS, frametime p95/p99, skin temperature, power draw, and visual pixels on hardware remain unmeasured until tested on device.

sme_sme2.notes: ARM SME/SME2 (including sme-i8i32, sme-f32f32). Useful for dense matrix/ML workloads; not applicable to irregular per-draw graphics command encoding where scalar/NEON 128-bit and cache locality dominate.

uncontended_mutex_lock_unlock.notes: os_unfair_lock / pthread_mutex fast path with LSE atomics

contended_mutex_wakeup.notes: ulock kernel transition under cross-thread contention

objc_msgSend_hot.notes: IMP cache hit; ARC retain/release pair adds ~6-12 ns

ios_jetsam_practical_limit_gib_est.notes: Unified pool shared by guest memory, Metal private textures, Metal heaps/arenas, shader libraries/PSOs, .NET NativeAOT heap, and iOS system buffers. Exceeding jetsam threshold kills process immediately.

metal_api.argument_tables: MTL4ArgumentTable (explicit slot addresses, persisted across encoders)
metal_api.command_allocators: MTL4CommandAllocator (per-frame ring reuse avoids per-submit allocation)
metal_api.metalfx: Temporal & Spatial upscaling + MetalFX Frame Interpolation
tbdr_rules: Never split an open render pass mid-draw unless GPU starvation strictly outweighs the 2x attachment DRAM round-trip (Store + Load of every bound MRT + depth/stencil attachment).
Prefer MTLLoadActionClear / DontCare and MTLStoreActionDontCare for transient attachments proven dead before next read.
Keep feedback reads on-chip (programmable blending / [[color(N)]]) or reuse cached snapshots across color-only passes and alternating depth targets.
Prefer FP16 (half) in compute/post-processing shaders (e.g., optical flow / motion vectors) to double ALU throughput and halve register/threadgroup pressure under Dynamic Caching.
Avoid redundant MTLResidencySet commit() calls on the submit critical path; pool & reuse private textures.

applicability_to_s2arm.rationale: CoreML/ANE dispatch incurs ~0.3-1.5 ms synchronization/marshaling overhead per call and requires quantized fixed-shape tensor graphs. It is unsuitable for microsecond-scale NVN command replay, hash lookups, or argument encoding. Its only technically relevant niche is offline/asynchronous workloads or fixed-cadence MetalFX/upscaling/frame-interpolation models when Apple's MetalFX runtime delegates subgraphs transparently.

ios_scheduling.qos_classes: USER_INTERACTIVE (0x21) for submit/present; UTILITY (0x11) for background shader translation/prewarm.
ios_scheduling.rt_thread_policy_caveat: Mach THREAD_TIME_CONSTRAINT_POLICY overruns (when actual computation exceeds declared budget) trigger kernel demotion onto E-cores. Reducing submit CPU instructions and locks is therefore doubly leveraged: fewer cycles AND higher sustained P-core residency.

ios_jit_and_compilation.mtl_compiler_service_contention: Synchronous MTLLibrary / MTLRenderPipelineState compilation competes with gameplay CPU/RAM and can stall 50-2000+ ms. Background CPU-only NVN2->MSL translation + bounded Fluid Pipelines + disk prewarming are essential.

analytical_cost_model.description: Maps host-measured operation deltas to estimated A18 Pro per-frame savings (60 FPS budget = 16.667 ms). All projections carry explicit uncertainty bounds.

unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.parameter: x86-64 Ir to ARM64 Ir translation ratio
unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.notes: ARM64 fixed 32-bit instructions vs x86-64 CISC; relative % reductions on identical C algorithms transfer accurately (±15%) even when absolute Ir differs.

unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.parameter: Real Apple9 TBDR lossless compression ratio per scene
unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.notes: Depends on color/depth entropy of each game's render targets; uncompressed logical byte reductions give an upper bound, compressed effective savings scale by this factor.

unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.parameter: XNU scheduler P-core vs E-core placement under live thermal state
unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.uncertainty_range: 2.0x to 2.8x wall-clock swing between Sawtooth @ 1.4-1.6 GHz and Everest @ 3.5-4.0 GHz
unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.notes: Reported as a dual interval [P-core nominal, E-core throttled] instead of a single fake point estimate.

unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.parameter: Apple Metal driver internal CPU encoding cost (MTL4RenderCommandEncoder)
unknown_parameters_and_uncertainties.notes: Cannot be timed directly on Linux; modeled via operation counters (pass splits, encoder openings, table writes, residency commits) and validated for compilation/correctness on macOS CI runners.
